title: Brave disclosed prompt injections in Perplexity Comet via hidden screenshot text and in Fellou via page navigation
summary: Brave's security team disclosed two indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities in agentic AI browsers: in Perplexity Comet, instructions hidden as faint light-blue text on a yellow background were recovered when the user took a screenshot and asked the assistant about it, and in Fellou, visible instructions on a web page took effect as soon as the user asked the assistant to navigate there, with no summarization request needed. The Comet issue was reported to Perplexity on 1 October 2025 and the Fellou issue to Fellou on 20 August 2025; Brave withheld one further vulnerability in another browser at that vendor's request (later identified as Opera Neon), described indirect prompt injection as a systemic challenge for the whole AI-browser category, and said browsers should isolate agentic browsing from regular browsing and start agentic actions only on explicit user invocation.
